question: Will Bitcoin reach $100,000 before the end of 2025?

question: Will Donald Trump win the 2024 US Presidential Election?
macro_context: Biden debate performance severely weakened Democratic position. Harris entered race July 21 after Biden dropped out. Trump polling leads in key swing states. Republican enthusiasm elevated.

question: Will the Federal Reserve cut interest rates at least once in 2024?

question: Will a spot Ethereum ETF be approved in the United States in 2024?

question: Will Joe Biden drop out of the 2024 US Presidential race before August 2024?
macro_context: Biden's June 27 debate performance was widely seen as disqualifying. Democratic donors and elected officials publicly calling for him to step aside. Internal party pressure building rapidly.
notes: Biden announced withdrawal from the race on July 21, 2024

question: Will the UK Labour Party win the 2024 UK general election?
macro_context: Conservatives polling 20 points behind Labour after Truss budget debacle, NHS crisis, and cost-of-living crisis. First-past-the-post system amplifies polling leads structurally. Sunak called snap election for July 4.
notes: Labour won historic landslide on July 4, 2024 under Keir Starmer

question: Will China invade or initiate a military blockade of Taiwan in 2024?
macro_context: PLA exercises increased post-Taiwan elections but full-scale invasion would be logistically unprecedented. US 7th Fleet maintains deterrence. Economic interdependence creates mutual constraints. Near-term invasion probability assessed very low by most analysts.
notes: No invasion or blockade of Taiwan occurred in 2024

question: Will the S&P 500 close above 5,000 for the first time ever by end of 2024?

question: Will SpaceX Starship achieve a successful orbital flight test in 2024?

question: Will Emmanuel Macron resign as French President before January 2025?
macro_context: Macron dissolved parliament after poor EU election results. Minority government formed but Macron constitutionally serves a fixed term until 2027. No constitutional mechanism for forced resignation under French Fifth Republic.
notes: Macron did not resign; remains president of France

question: Will Ethereum price exceed $4,000 in 2024?

question: Will US CPI (year-over-year) fall below 3% in 2024?

question: Will a major G20 country (GDP > $1T) experience a debt crisis requiring IMF bailout in 2024?

question: Will Kamala Harris win the 2024 US Presidential Election?
macro_context: Harris entered race after Biden withdrew July 21. Generated enthusiasm and fundraising surge. Led some national polls but swing state polling showed Trump ahead in most. Prediction markets had Trump at 55-60% favorite heading into November.

question: Will the ECB cut interest rates before the US Federal Reserve in 2024?

question: Will global CO2 emissions set a new record high in 2024?

question: Will Nvidia stock price exceed $800 per share at any point in 2024?

question: Will Russia and Ukraine sign a formal ceasefire agreement in 2024?
macro_context: Front lines largely static in 2024. Ukraine counter-offensive stalled in 2023. Russia making slow gains. Neither side has indicated willingness to negotiate in 2024. Western support continues. Peace talks not scheduled.

question: Will Tesla deliver fewer than 400,000 vehicles in Q1 2024?
